verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an API platform can reasonably publish an OpenAPI spec, but the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.stripe.com returning 404. Nothing in the docs mentions a downloadable machine-readable spec. Adjacent artifacts do not qualify: llms.txt, markdown docs, the skills JSON index, the human-readable MPP spec site, and the open-source ACP specification with no stated machine-readable format.
